```
export function setupCounter(element) {
  let counter = 0
  const setCounter = (count) => {
    counter = count
    element.innerHTML = `Count is ${counter}`
  }
  element.addEventListener('click', () => setCounter(counter + 1))
  setCounter(0)
}
```
</details></tool-use>

```javascript
  {

    blurb: 'Carburetors over computers. Ben thinks cars peaked somewhere around 1969.',

    name: 'Track Days',
    blurb: "It's not a hobby, it's a lifestyle. Lap times are a personality trait.",
  },
  {
    emoji: '🔧',
    name: 'Project Builds',
    blurb: "Currently 'almost done' for the third year running.",
  },
  {
    emoji: '⚡',
    name: 'EVs',
    blurb: "Ben has complicated feelings about these, but can't deny the torque.",
  },
]

const facts = [
  'The first speeding ticket was issued in 1902 to a driver going a blistering 45 mph.',
  'The Bugatti Veyron\'s tires were rated for a top speed of 258 mph but lasted only 15 minutes at that speed.',
  'The average car has around 30,000 parts, including every nut and bolt.',
  'The Koenigsegg Agera RS once held the record for fastest production car at 277.9 mph.',
  'Red cars are commonly believed to get pulled over more, but studies show it has more to do with how the car is driven.',
  'The Volkswagen Beetle was originally designed in the 1930s and stayed in production for over 65 years.',
  'A Formula 1 car can generate enough downforce to drive upside down in a tunnel at high speed.',
  'The first car radio was offered by Motorola in 1930, and it cost almost as much as the car itself.',
  'The McLaren F1 used gold foil in its engine bay because gold is one of the best heat reflectors.',
  'The windshield wiper was invented by a woman, Mary Anderson, in 1903.',
  'Ferrari produces far fewer cars per year than most people guess, on purpose, to keep them exclusive.',
  'The term "horsepower" was coined by James Watt to compare the output of steam engines to actual horses.',
]

let lastFactIndex = -1

function randomFact() {
  let index = Math.floor(Math.random() * facts.length)
  if (facts.length > 1) {
    while (index === lastFactIndex) {
      index = Math.floor(Math.random() * facts.length)
    }
  }
  lastFactIndex = index
  return facts[index]
}
```

```css
:root {
  --bg: #0b0b0e;
  --bg-alt: #141418;
  --text: #e9e9ee;
  --text-dim: #a9a9b3;
  --accent: #e10600;
  --accent-dim: rgba(225, 6, 0, 0.15);
  --yellow: #ffcc00;
  --border: #2a2a32;

  font: 18px/1.5 system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
  color: var(--text);
  background: var(--bg);
  font-synthesis: none;
  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

* {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
}

h1,
h2,
h3 {
  font-family: inherit;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--text);
  margin: 0 0 12px;
}

p {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--text-dim);
}

a {
  color: var(--accent);
}

#app {
  min-height: 100svh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

/* Header */
.site-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 20px 32px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  background: rgba(11, 11, 14, 0.9);
  backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
  z-index: 10;
}

.brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 20px;
}

.brand-emoji {
  font-size: 24px;
}

.site-nav {
  display: flex;
  gap: 24px;
}

.site-nav a {
  color: var(--text-dim);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: color 0.2s;
}

.site-nav a:hover {
  color: var(--accent);
}

/* Hero */
.hero {
  position: relative;
  text-align: center;
  padding: 100px 20px 60px;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% -10%, var(--accent-dim), transparent 60%);
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hero-kicker {
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 3px;
  color: var(--yellow);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.hero h1 {
  font-size: clamp(36px, 6vw, 64px);
  letter-spacing: -1px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.hero-tagline {
  font-size: 20px;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
}

.cta {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 14px 28px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: none;
  font-size: 16px;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
}

.cta:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(225, 6, 0, 0.35);
}

.road {
  margin-top: 60px;
  height: 10px;
  background: #1c1c22;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 999px;
}

.lane {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    90deg,
    var(--yellow) 0,
    var(--yellow) 40px,
    transparent 40px,
    transparent 80px
  );
  animation: drive 3s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes drive {
  from {
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
  to {
    transform: translateX(-80px);
  }
}

/* Shared section styling */
section {
  padding: 72px 24px;
  max-width: 1100px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  width: 100%;
  text-align: center;
}

.section-sub {
  margin-bottom: 36px;
}

/* Garage */
.garage-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
  gap: 20px;
}

.garage-card {
  background: var(--bg-alt);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 28px 20px;
  text-align: left;
  transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s;
}

.garage-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  transform: translateY(-4px);
}

.garage-emoji {
  font-size: 36px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.garage-card h3 {
  font-size: 18px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.garage-card p {
  font-size: 15px;
}

/* Facts */
.facts {
  background: var(--bg-alt);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}

.fact-box {
  background: var(--bg);
  border: 1px dashed var(--border);
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 28px;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  min-height: 80px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.fact-box p {
  color: var(--text);
  font-size: 17px;
}

/* About */
.about p {
  max-width: 640px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  font-size: 17px;
}

/* Footer */
.site-footer {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 24px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--text-dim);
  font-size: 14px;
}
```
